title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and cleanup actions deps
author: Evelyn Park
release_notes: Consolidates CI workflows to reduce duplicated runs and improve cache hit rates. Bumps major GH Actions versions (actions/checkout, actions/setup-node) and extracts release automation into a single workflow. No user-facing API changes.
description: Motivation: Our repo has accumulated multiple overlapping GitHub Actions workflows for lint/test and release automation. This PR unifies lint and test matrices into shared composite actions, extracts release automation into a single dedicated workflow, and updates commonly used actions to newer major versions to address security and performance issues. Goals: 1) Reduce PR CI run time and cost by running a lightweight PR validation path and running full integration pipelines on main; 2) Improve cache hit rates by standardizing cache keys and moving common steps to composite actions; 3) Reduce maintenance surface by centralizing release automation and limiting duplicated job definitions; 4) Upgrade GH Actions dependencies (actions/checkout, setup-node, cache) to supported major versions. Changes: - New .github/workflows/pr-validate.yml: lightweight matrix for lint + unit tests optimized for fast feedback. - New .github/workflows/release.yml: consolidated release automation (tagging, changelog, publish) with explicit guards for protected branches and release windows. - Consolidated test/lint steps into .github/actions/composites/lint-test.yml for reuse across repo. - Bumped actions/checkout to v4 and actions/setup-node to v4 across workflows. - Adjusted cache keys: node-modules and build outputs now include repo checksum + lockfile hash; added cache priming job to improve first-run behavior for long-lived branches. - Small package.json devDeps alignments for CI only (eslint-config, jest) to reduce transitive audit warnings. Rollout plan: Deploy changes to main and monitor first 72h of CI metrics (queue time, run time, cache hit rate). Revert strategy: rollout in two stages—merge then monitor; if regressions found, revert via the repo UI or reintroduce previous workflow files. Checklist: - [x] Extracted common steps into composite actions - [x] Updated action major versions and validated breaking notes - [x] Added targeted PR validation workflow to speed up feedback - [x] Added release workflow with explicit guards - [x] Ran full CI on this branch and validated green on main-like runs Risks: - Minor differences in node setup between setup-node v2 and v4; validated with matrix entries for node 18 and 20. - Cache key changes may reduce hit rate initially; added priming job to mitigate. Related: ENG-1284 (CI hygiene), ENG-2150 (release automation improvements), SUP-4312 (support incident that motivated faster PR feedback).
